To improve, add the missing abstract and visuals, correct the Volkswagen case, complete your references, and build a decision framework explaining when known-defect products may ship and how accepting the contract fits with not shipping.

To reach Good, add a ~150-word abstract, correct typos such as 'DICUSSION', 'of could', 'ofprofessional', 'Actin' and 'ofcompetence', add at least one relevant figure/table, and fix inconsistent/incomplete references (e.g., [3] lacks a URL).
